name: Normal Conditions
description: All roads are open and flood risk remains low to moderate for baseline comparison.

name: Bridge Flooded
description: The main bridge road is blocked due to severe flooding.

name: Severe Flooding
description: Several roads receive elevated flood-risk values so the safer route becomes different from the shortest route.

name: Shelter Unavailable
description: One shelter is at capacity and unavailable, so another evacuation centre must be selected.

name: Multiple Equal-Cost Paths
description: Two or more routes are configured to have similar overall cost so tie-breaking behaviour becomes visible.
